# Alembic migrations

Database migrations for the snapd-invest engine.

## Common commands

```bash
# Apply all pending migrations
uv run alembic upgrade head

# Create a new migration from model changes (autogenerated)
uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m "<short description>"

# Roll back one migration (asks for approval via .claude/hooks)
uv run alembic downgrade -1

# Show current revision
uv run alembic current

# Show full history
uv run alembic history
```

## Conventions

- One migration per logical schema change. Don't bundle unrelated changes.
- Always inspect autogenerated migrations before committing — Alembic isn't perfect at detecting renames.
- Use `render_as_batch=True` (already set in `env.py`) for SQLite compatibility. PostgreSQL ignores it; SQLite requires it for ALTER TABLE-style changes.
- Avoid SQLite-only data types. Stick to standard SQLAlchemy column types so the migration also works against PostgreSQL.
- Migrations are checked into git. Never modify a committed migration — write a new one instead.

## Initial migration

The initial schema baseline is `2026_05_12_*_initial_schema.py`. Treat it as the canonical starting point.
